description.en: Open the Explorer at Plantae to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开植物，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open the rounded 451.7 Ma Sandbian–Katian window for twelve spore-mass fragments from core 21 of the Ghaba-1 well in northern Oman, and inspect the bounded land-plant evidence.
description.zh: 打开取整为451.7 Ma的桑比期—凯迪期窗口，检查阿曼北部Ghaba-1钻孔21号岩芯的十二件孢子团碎片及其有边界的陆生植物证据。

limitations: The source assigns the fragments to Late Ordovician Caradoc strata using palynology and sequence stratigraphy; 451.7 Ma is a broad numerical display midpoint for the legacy regional stage window, not a direct specimen date or global land-plant FAD/LAD.

Permanent tetrads, dyads and presumed sporangial covering support land-plant spore production, while lamellate wall ultrastructure only suggests liverwort affinity; the producer and its relationship to living clades remain unresolved.
Map markers show bounded Ghaba-1 sampled context subject to preservation and collection bias, not a complete distribution, direct ancestry or exact fossil-to-paleomap co-registration.

description.en: Open the rounded 411.5 Ma Rhynie Chert window for named Horneophyton lignieri museum slides and inspect the confocal evidence for thick-walled conducting cells.
description.zh: 打开取整为411.5 Ma的莱尼燧石窗口，检查具名Horneophyton lignieri博物馆切片及其厚壁输导细胞的共聚焦证据。

limitations: The 411.5 ± 1.3 Ma window dates the Rhynie Chert-bearing succession via an andesitic lava; it constrains the deposit rather than directly dating every slide and is not a global Horneophyton FAD/LAD or lineage duration.

Confocal sections of the selected NHMUK slides show papillate or labyrinthine wall ingrowths and no distinct xylem/phloem; transfer-cell resemblance and transport function are interpretations, not direct observations of physiology or a universal ancestral vascular system.

Map markers show the represented Aberdeenshire, Scotland museum sample with preservation and collection bias, not a complete geographic distribution, direct ancestor or exact fossil-to-paleomap co-registration.

description.en: Open a narrow 407 Ma Rhynie Chert window for the serial-section and peel reconstruction of Asteroxylon mackiei, focusing on the attachment of rooting and root-bearing axes.
description.zh: 打开狭窄的407 Ma莱尼燧石窗口，检查Asteroxylon mackiei连续切片与剥离重建，聚焦生根轴与承根轴的连接。

limitations: The rounded 407 Ma age is a Rhynie Chert locality anchor for the named Asteroxylon mackiei material, not a directly dated specimen, global Lycopodiophyta FAD/LAD or continuous lineage range.

The reconstruction distinguishes leafy shoot, root-bearing and rooting axes and infers anisotomous dichotomy at a branch point; that developmental model is species-level evidence and is not direct ancestry or a trait assertion for all lycophytes.
Map markers show sampled Rhynie context subject to preservation and collection bias, not a complete distribution or exact fossil-to-paleomap co-registration.

title.zh: 胚胎植物冠群模型年龄窗口

description.en: Open the 473 Ma edge of the 515–473 Ma fossil-calibrated molecular-clock interval to inspect model context alongside Plantae range evidence; this card is not a fossil locality.
description.zh: 打开515–473 Ma化石校准分子钟区间的473 Ma边界，将模型语境与植物范围证据并置检查；本卡不代表化石地点。

limitations: The interval is a Bayesian relaxed-clock estimate based on 37 fossil calibrations and alternative bryophyte–tracheophyte topologies; it is model output, not a direct fossil first appearance, global FAD/LAD or observed terrestrial expansion.
The route uses the edge that overlaps the package’s available Plantae range only to keep the age-driven Explorer state valid; no specimen, formation or palaeocoordinate is implied by the model.

Any visible map context remains sampled occurrence data and model geometry with separate provenance; it does not establish a complete distribution, direct ancestry or exact fossil-to-paleomap co-registration.
